name: ttyd
description: Lightweight web-based terminal (Linux binary, optional). The canonical terminal is the built-in Python Tornado server on both platforms; ttyd is available as an optional alternative.
notes: Linux-only binary. The Python/Tornado terminal server (src/vnc_remote_secure/services/terminal.py) is the canonical terminal on both platforms; this manifest supports optional ttyd installs (e.g. `make ttyd-install`).
